title: 第5章 天生双系（上）

content_zh:
“下一个……”
“下一个……”
“张候！”
站在离莫凡不算太远的泥猴子张候回头给了莫凡一个眼神道：“莫凡哥，我过去了。”
“好好加油。”
“哼，祝你也是水系。”赵坤三马上说起了风凉话。
张候就是一个瘦猴干，手往那里一放，没多久一股奇异的风旋涡在觉醒石上显现，吹得老师得衣襟都有些鼓动了。
“很好，风系，天赋不错，要好好修炼，切勿偷懒！”薛木生脸上同样露出了满意之色。
班主任薛木生心里很开心，因为才到十几个号，自己班里就出现了两个优质天赋的学生，假如他们好好用功的话都是能够考上好的大学学府。
当然最让自己捡到宝的是1号学生穆白，卓越寒冰系天赋，加上他背后的寒冰系世家，未来的栋梁之才了！
看来这一届8班应该有机会名列前茅。
“下一个……”
“下一个……”
“下一个……”
“噗~~~~~”
觉醒石上，一道橙色的火苗突然窜起。
这一幕让全班人一下子瞪大了眼睛。
“火……火系！！！”
“靠，居然还是个妹子，这女生叫什么啊？”
一时间，觉醒的那个女生成为了全班的焦点，系算是元素系里面最为出彩的了，是所有魔徒级魔法师觉醒的首选，假如他们可以选择的话……

可惜火系比较傲娇，概率算低，一个班级里面最多也就3个，十分之一的概率都不到。
“她叫周敏，好像是我们某个老师的女儿。”有人小声的说道。
“长得还很漂亮啊，赶紧去认识下。”
“那可小心点，这周敏看上去很文静很乖，其实是暴力狂，不然一个女孩子怎么觉醒的是火炎系。”
“有道理，有道理。”
“算是女从母业，文华老师知道的话应该会很欣慰的。”班主任薛木生说道。
“谢谢老师。”
“下一个……风系”
“下一个……光系”
“老师，我去天台，你别拉我。”那个光系的同学说道。
“下一个……水系。”
“光系同学，等我下，我和你一起去天台。”
“下一个……”
终于几乎全班的系都觉醒了，莫凡手握着48号学号，内心狂跳不止，恐怕谁都没有莫凡内心这么紧张，一方面他是最近三个月才接触到的魔法，另一方面他真的担心会出现觉醒失败！
“48号，莫凡！”
“到你了！”张候转过头来鼓励道。
“砸锅卖铁才进来的，就别抱什么希望了，运气好点弄个水系、光系，修炼不到中阶法师级别就废了，运气不好，觉醒失败，啧啧啧，直接什么都陪掉咯。”赵坤三满嘴的风凉话道。
“你能闭上你狗嘴吗？”张候有些怒道。
在张候心里莫凡就是他大哥，虽然他魔法成绩很差，这次进魔法高中也是另谋途径，但他绝不希望看到莫凡觉醒的比别人差。
九年义务魔法教育其实就是为觉醒打下基础，也为之后的修行打下各种理论，不至于修行中摸不着头脑，假如没有学好，一方面觉醒会失败，另一方面修炼止步不前。

莫凡迈开了步子，穿过了人群。
“就是他啊，好像是走后门进来的。”
“这是谁啊，长得还挺帅的。”一个小女生萌萌的问道。
“很渣的一个学生啦，我原来就在他隔壁班。”另一个蘑菇头大嘴巴的女生说道。
“这样啊，那觉醒的可能很差。”
“能不能觉醒成功还是问题。”
“我说，那几个圣光系的、凌水系的，你们不要灰心啊，等等你们看这位莫凡同学的觉醒你们就很欣慰了，这家伙考试个位数的，基础差得要命，觉醒很可能失败。”这个时候赵坤三和张候骂急了，干脆大声的嘲讽了起来。
他这么一说，那些圣光系、凌水系的还真就擦亮眼睛了，假如有人奇葩的觉醒失败，那真是太让人……宽心了。
“不要喧哗！”薛木生瞪了一眼挑事的赵坤三。
穆白嘴角却微微一浮，要的就是莫凡当众出丑，这家伙本就是一个渣，有什么资格接近穆宁雪大小姐，自己这么帅，魔法天赋又好，还那么努力，穆宁雪应该会和自己关系很贴近才是。
“渣渣，我可是听说你家把房子都卖了供你来觉醒，你要觉醒失败了真就找个河跳下去一了百了好了，免得给你们家蒙羞。”穆白细声细语着，就在莫凡从他身边经过的时候说道。

content_en:
"Next..."
"Next..."
"Zhang Hou!"
Zhang Hou, the mud monkey who was standing not too far away from Mo Fan, turned around and gave Mo Fan a look and said, "Brother Mo Fan, I'm coming over."
"Come on."
"Hmph, I hope you are also a water element." Zhao Kunsan immediately made a sarcastic comment.
Zhang Hou was just a skinny monkey. As soon as he put his hand there, a strange vortex of wind appeared on the awakening stone, blowing so hard that the teacher's clothes were fluttering.
"Very good, wind element, good talent. Practice hard and don't be lazy!" Xue Musheng also had a look of satisfaction on his face.
The class teacher, Xue Musheng, was very happy because there were already two talented students in his class after only ten days. If they studied hard, they would be able to get into good universities.
Of course, the one who made me find the most treasure was student No. 1 Mu Bai. With his outstanding talent in the ice system and the ice family behind him, he was a future pillar of talent!
It seems that Class 8 should have a chance to be at the top this time.
"Next..."
"Next..."
"Next..."
“Pfft~~~~~”
On the awakening stone, an orange flame suddenly shot up.
This scene made the whole class' eyes widen at once.
"Fire...fire element!!!"
"Damn, she's actually a girl. What's this girl's name?"
For a time, the awakened girl became the focus of the whole class. She was considered the most outstanding in the elemental department and was the first choice for all demon-level magicians to awaken. If they could choose...
Unfortunately, the fire type is more arrogant, so the probability is low. There are only 3 in a class at most, and the probability is less than 1 in 10.
"Her name is Zhou Min, she seems to be the daughter of one of our teachers." Someone whispered.
"She's very beautiful. Go and get to know her quickly."
"Then be careful. Zhou Min looks very quiet and well-behaved, but he is actually violent. Otherwise, how could a girl awaken to the fire element?"
"It makes sense, it makes sense."
"It's considered a daughter's job. Teacher Wenhua would be very pleased to know about it," said class teacher Xue Musheng.
"Thank you, teacher."
"Next...wind element"
"Next...light system"
"Teacher, I'm going to the rooftop, don't hold me back." said the light classmate.
"Next...water type."
"Light classmate, wait until I get off and I'll go to the rooftop with you."
"Next..."
Finally, almost all departments in the class have awakened. Mo Fan holds student number 48 in his hand and his heart is beating wildly. I am afraid that no one is as nervous as Mo Fan. On the one hand, he has only come into contact with magic in the past three months. On the other hand, he is really worried that the awakening will fail!
"No. 48, Mo Fan!"
"It's your turn!" Zhang Hou turned his head and encouraged.
"You just got here by selling iron, so don't hold out any hope. If you are lucky, you can get a water element or a light element. If you don't reach the intermediate mage level, you will be useless. If you are unlucky and fail to awaken, you will lose everything." Zhao Kunsan said with a cool voice.
"Can you shut up your stupid mouth?" Zhang Hou said angrily.
In Zhang Hou's heart, Mo Fan is his eldest brother. Although his magic scores are very poor and he is looking for another way to enter the magic high school this time, he never wants to see Mo Fan awakening worse than others.
The nine-year compulsory magic education is actually to lay the foundation for awakening, and also to lay various theories for subsequent practice, so that you will not be confused during practice. If you do not learn well, on the one hand, the awakening will fail, and on the other hand, the practice will stop.
Mo Fan took a step forward and passed through the crowd.
"That's him. He seems to have come in through the back door."
"Who is this? He's quite handsome." A little girl asked cutely.
"What a scumbag student. I was in the class next to him." Another girl with a mushroom head and a big mouth said.
"That's right. The awakening might be bad."
"CanFailure to successfully awaken is still a problem. "
"I said, those Holy Light and Lingshui people, don't be discouraged. You will be very happy when you see this student Mo Fan awakening. This guy's exam is in the single digits. His foundation is very poor, and his awakening is likely to fail. "At this time, Zhao Kunsan and Zhang Hou were so angry that they started to taunt loudly.
When he said this, those of the Holy Light and Lingshui systems really opened their eyes. If someone failed to awaken in a strange way, it would be really... reassuring.
"Don't make any noise! "Xue Musheng glared at Zhao Kunsan who was provoking trouble.
Mu Bai's lips curled up slightly. What he wanted was for Mo Fan to make a fool of himself in public. This guy was a scumbag, so what qualifications did he have to get close to Miss Mu Ningxue? He was so handsome, had good magic talent, and worked so hard. Mu Ningxue should be very close to him.
"Zhazha, I heard that your family sold all their houses for you to awaken. If you fail to awaken, just find a river and jump into it, so as not to bring shame to your family. "Mu Bai whispered as Mo Fan passed by him.
